label: Bible Study
prompt: Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and cry against it; for their _____ is come up before me.
verse: Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and cry against it; for their wickedness is come up before me.
note: Jonah's assignment — go to Nineveh; he immediately bought a ticket to the opposite end of the map.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And they said one to another, Did not our heart _____ within us, while he talked with us by the way, and while he opened to us the scriptures?
verse: And they said one to another, Did not our heart burn within us, while he talked with us by the way, and while he opened to us the scriptures?
note: Two disciples on the Emmaus road realize why their hearts burned as the stranger talked — it was Jesus.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And Jesus said unto him, Go thy way; thy faith hath made thee _____. And immediately he received his sight, and followed Jesus in the way.
verse: And Jesus said unto him, Go thy way; thy faith hath made thee whole. And immediately he received his sight, and followed Jesus in the way.
note: 'Thy faith hath made thee whole' — and the first thing Bartimaeus did with his new sight was follow Jesus.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And said, Hitherto shalt thou come, but no further: and here shall thy proud _____ be stayed?
verse: And said, Hitherto shalt thou come, but no further: and here shall thy proud waves be stayed?
note: God sets the sea its limits like a parent at a playpen: this far, and no further.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: As the _____ sitteth on eggs, and hatcheth them not; so he that getteth riches, and not by right, shall leave them in the midst of his days, and at his end shall be a fool.
verse: As the partridge sitteth on eggs, and hatcheth them not; so he that getteth riches, and not by right, shall leave them in the midst of his days, and at his end shall be a fool.
note: Ill-gotten riches are like a 'partridge' sitting on eggs that never hatch — 'at his end' such a man 'shall be a fool.'
